=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:307-341 (PR_DIFF capture + python truncation) + 415 (note rendering) | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `PR_DIFF` is capped only in the diff snippet, but the full rendered prompt can still exceed the CLI's 1 MiB `turn/start` envelope on pathological PRs.
  WHY: The untrusted PR-derived content plus static sections can still breach the envelope before any model turn, causing the codex invocation to fail upstream.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:554-567 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The prompt-size diagnostic is measured after `sanitize_codex_prompt_file` but only once per judge invocation, so later retries reuse a potentially stale size.
  WHY: If sanitization changes prompt size on retry paths, warnings can be missing or outdated while the actual stdin payload changes.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:322-340 + 415 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The byte-bound truncation can leave the downstream prompt with a broken or partial diff render.
  WHY: A mid-hunk or split-header excerpt can mislead the judge into wrong mergeability or follow-up decisions.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:390-430 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: A second copy of the already-capped diff is embedded into the Semble query before the full prompt is rendered.
  WHY: Combined with Semble prefetch and metadata, this can still push stdin over the codex envelope even when the later DIFF section is truncated.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:312,322,554 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Validation is incomplete: empty `PR_DIFF_BYTES_TOTAL`, suppressed `wc` errors, and a warning threshold unrelated to `RB_JUDGE_PR_DIFF_MAX_BYTES` leave oversized prompts unguarded.
  WHY: Silent zero-size measurement or missing guards can let the same oversized prompt retry through the ladder without a useful warning.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:554-567 + JUDGE_ATTEMPT_LEVELS loop | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Prompt-size measurement and sanitization are repeated on every retry even though the prompt file is unchanged across levels.
  WHY: This adds unnecessary I/O and string processing, and the retry ladder is dead weight once the envelope is already breached.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:318,415,560 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The variables and log messages mix byte-based math with the CLI's documented character limit.
  WHY: Operators get misleading diagnostics, and future tuning is harder because the warning text and math no longer speak the same unit.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:575-581 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `RB_JUDGE_PROMPT_BYTES` is measured with `wc -c` bytes but compared against Codex's 1,048,576-character envelope.
  WHY: For multi-byte content, byte count diverges from character count, so the 950000 warning threshold can fire too early or too late.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:575-581 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `RB_JUDGE_PROMPT_SIZE_LOGGED=true` makes the prompt-size diagnostic run only once, even though sanitization runs on every retry.
  WHY: If sanitization changes the prompt size on a later retry, the logged size becomes stale and subsequent envelope risks go unreported.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:307-341 (PR_DIFF capture + python truncation) + 415 (note rendering) | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `PR_DIFF` comes from untrusted `gh api ...diff`, and the byte cap + UTF-8 repair is applied only to the diff snippet, not the full rendered prompt.
  WHY: The full prompt can still exceed the CLI's 1 MiB `turn/start` envelope before any model turn, causing every retry to fail the same way.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:554-567 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic `RB_JUDGE_PROMPT_SIZE_LOGGED` block measures after the first `sanitize_codex_prompt_file "${RB_JUDGE_PROMPT}"` but runs once per judge invocation.
  WHY: Subsequent retry iterations reuse the potentially mutated file without re-measuring, so warnings can be stale or absent.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:322-340 + 415 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Truncation always cuts at a byte boundary with a simple UTF-8 repair loop, but the downstream prompt render can still print a partial diff.
  WHY: The judge can receive a syntactically broken patch and make incorrect mergeability or follow-up decisions based on the broken prefix.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:390-430 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `append_review_rb_semble_query_section "PR diff excerpt:" "${PR_DIFF}" 5000` embeds a second copy of the already-capped diff into the Semble query before the full prompt render.
  WHY: Combined with `REVIEW_RB_SEMBLE_MAX_CHUNKS=4` and prefetch, the prompt can still exceed the cap even when the later DIFF section is truncated.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:312,322,554 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Validation guards are incomplete: `PR_DIFF_BYTES_TOTAL` can be empty, the size-log block suppresses `wc` errors, and the warning threshold is not tied to `RB_JUDGE_PR_DIFF_MAX_BYTES`.
  WHY: Silent zero-size measurement on I/O errors can hide envelope violations and waste retries on the same oversized prompt.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:554-567 + JUDGE_ATTEMPT_LEVELS loop | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Prompt-size measurement and `sanitize_codex_prompt_file` run on every iteration of the retry ladder even though the prompt file is identical across levels.
  WHY: The extra I/O and string processing consume job budget without changing the outcome once the envelope is already breached.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:318,415,560 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Variable names and log messages mix "bytes" (`wc -c`) with the CLI's documented 1,048,576-character limit.
  WHY: The truncation note and warning text remain misleading, and future tuning of `RB_JUDGE_PR_DIFF_MAX_BYTES` becomes harder to reason about.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
